caption: Storage full again? It's usually these five, and videos are the big one. Save this for the next time the warning pops up.

slides.title: 5 things *quietly* eating your storage
slides.body: Start with number 1. It's usually the biggest.

slides.label: for one minute of 4K video at 60 fps
slides.body: A five-minute clip is about **2 GB**. The same clip at 1080p is about 300 MB.
slides.source: Apple's estimates in Settings → Camera → Record Video. They vary by iPhone.

slides.title: Live Photos
slides.body: Each one saves a still **plus a short video**. Turning Live off in Edit doesn't free the space, because the video is kept.
slides.tip: keep the still, drop the clip

slides.title: Screenshots
slides.body: iPhone saves them as PNG, a format built for perfect copies, not small files. And most of us never delete one.

slides.title: Bursts and extra copies
slides.body: Hold the shutter and you get a dozen near-identical shots. You only need the best one.

slides.title: Chat attachments
slides.body: Photos and videos people send you in Messages and WhatsApp are stored on your phone too.
